      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.strict_complement {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] {X W : TwoTerm R} (r : CategoryTheory.Retract X.asArrow W.asArrow) :
      ∃ (Y : TwoTerm R) (s : CategoryTheory.Retract Y.asArrow W.asArrow), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp s.r s.i = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id W.asArrow - CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp r.r r.i ∧ W.projectiveClass = X.projectiveClass + Y.projectiveClass ∧ (X.projectiveClass ≠ 0 → arrowEndDim k Y < arrowEndDim k W)

      Splitting a strict retract splits its class. A summand with nonzero class leaves a complement of strictly smaller endomorphism dimension.
